summary.text: John Santorello is the Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Washington-3 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: John Santorello was the Republican candidate for Vermont House of Representatives Washington 3 in 2012, when he was unopposed in the primary and finished third in the general election with 1,192 votes (25.5%).
In 2014 he was again unopposed in the Republican primary for the district, alongside Kristin Sohlstrom, and the district's two seats were won by Paul Poirier and Tommy Walz.
